title: 1995 PlayStation launch: 3 surprising facts

scenes.text: It shipped over 1 million units in its first month, a record for a new console.
scenes.label: OVER 1M UNITS SOLD

scenes.text: The original disc could hold 650 MB, triple the CD-ROM size of competing systems.
scenes.label: 650MB DISC CAPACITY

scenes.text: Its launch title, *Ridge Racer*, introduced the world to 3‑D polygon racing on a home console.
scenes.label: RIDGE RACER DEBUT

scenes.text: Follow for daily tech you should actually know.

description: The PlayStation’s 1995 debut reshaped home gaming with record sales, massive discs, and a breakthrough racing title. Stay tuned for deeper dives.
